model_annotation: The provided bar chart visually represents the overall performance of various large language models (LLMs) in the ABS-AOS pattern, with performance values expressed as percentages along the vertical axis, which ranges from 0 to 60 and is marked with regular tick intervals of 20. The horizontal axis lists individual LLMs, each represented by a distinct colored bar with its corresponding performance percentage explicitly labeled atop the bar. The bars are arranged in a single row without explicit sorting, and no visual highlighting or grouping is present. The performance values displayed range from a minimum of 24.64% to a maximum of 61.09%. The caption indicates that these models are stratified into three tiers based on their OP_GM scores: Tier-1 (55–61), Tier-2 (41–49), and Tier-3 (25–27), although the chart itself does not visually encode or group the bars according to these tiers.
